question: Which of the following festivals of Mizoram is celebrated to promote horticulture?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anthurium **__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anthurium:**

 
 
• The Anthurium festival is a major tourism event in Mizoram.
 
• It is specifically organized to promote the cultivation and marketing of Anthurium flowers.
 
• The festival showcases the beauty and variety of Anthurium flowers grown in the region.
 
• It aims to boost the local horticulture industry and attract tourists.
 
• It is celebrated in Thenzawl.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hlukhla Kut:**

 
 
• Hlukhla Kut is a festival associated with the harvest and thanksgiving.
 
• It is a traditional festival that celebrates the successful gathering of crops.
 
• It is a time for feasting, singing, and dancing.
 
• It is a celebration of the bounty of the land.
 
• It is a post harvest festival.
 
 
 
• **Khuado Kut:**
 
 
• Khuado Kut is a harvest festival celebrated in Mizoram.
 
• It is a time to give thanks for a good harvest and to pray for prosperity.
 
• It involves rituals, feasts, and cultural performances.
 
• It is a traditional festival that reflects the agricultural roots of the Mizo people.
 
• It is a festival to appease spirits.
 
 
 
• **Lyuva Khutla:**
 
 
• Information on "Lyuva Khutla" is limited, and it is not widely recognized as a major festival in Mizoram.
 
• It is possible that there are local or less well known festivals that have similar names.
 
• The primary recognised festivals are those related to harvest, and specific flower cultivation.
